thought.text: Connection works with explicit credentials. Now the actual BCrypt match:

reasoning_content: OK, the connection is working with explicit root/root. The hash is a 60-character bcrypt hash. Next, let's do the actual BCrypt match using proper quoting.

action.command: cd /workspace && timeout 300 ruby -e 'require "bcrypt"; require "active_record"; ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(adapter: "postgresql", host: "localhost", database: "consul_development", username: "root", password: "root"); h = ActiveRecord::Base.connection.select_value("select encrypted_password from users where email='\''admin@consul.dev'\''"); puts "admin match: #{BCrypt::Password.new(h) == "Aa12345678"}"; %w[mod manager valuator verified unverified].each do |r|; h2 = ActiveRecord::Base.connection.select_value("select encrypted_password from users where email='\''#{r}@consul.dev'\''"); puts "#{r} match: #{BCrypt::Password.new(h2) == "Aa12345678" rescue "NOHASH"}"; end' 2>&1 | tail -8
